# jasnauskaite.lt — Inidė Jasnauskaitė-Jonaitė

## About
Content creator based in Vilnius, Lithuania. 364K Instagram followers, 125K TikTok.
788 branded posts across 156 brands. 577M+ Instagram views. 8+ years of experience.
Working with the biggest Lithuanian and international brands.

## What I Do
Fashion, beauty, lifestyle & travel content creation for brands.
Services: Instagram Reels, Stories, Posts, TikTok content.
Full production: concept, filming, editing, color grading, post-production.

## Key Results
- 156 brand partners including Mionetto, Akropolis, Nissan, Hellmann's, Lancôme, McDonald's, Maxima, Barbora, Tele2, Milka
- 111 of 156 brands booked more than once
- 5.9% engagement rate (feed only, stories excluded; platform average 1.9%)
- 788 branded posts — a new one every 3.7 days, on average
- Top organic reel: 37.2M views
- Top case: Mionetto — 30 posts, 17.2M total views, top reel 6.9M views
